summary: A hawkish Fed repricing and a stronger dollar have weighed heavily on gold through Q2, with rising real yields and renewed enthusiasm for tech stocks pulling capital away from the metal. Stocks rebounded to start the week as oil prices fell and tech led a broad return from the holiday weekend, with the Nasdaq and S&P 500 gaining on the back of tech, financials, and industrials.
tweet: Tech stocks staged a fresh rally as investors rotated back into growth from defensive assets, while a 57K June payrolls miss slashed September hike odds and kept VIX contained.
